description: This source file defines a ViewModel class for managing the state and interactions of a chat UI in a Swift application. It handles messaging, session management, model selection, event handling, and communication with a transport layer for an AI chat system.

classes.name: OpenClawChatViewModel
classes.description: A class managing the state and interactions of a chat UI, including messaging, session handling, model selection, and communication with a backend transport.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Initializes or reloads the chat session, fetching history, models, and health status.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the session data, similar to load.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends the current input message and attachments.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts any pending message send or response fetch.

methods.name: refreshSessions
methods.description: Fetches the latest list of chat sessions.

methods.name: switchSession
methods.description: Switches the active chat session to the specified session key.

methods.name: selectThinkingLevel
methods.description: Sets the thinking level (e.g., off, low, high) for the chat session.

methods.name: selectModel
methods.description: Selects a different AI model for the chat session.

methods.name: addImageAttachment
methods.description: Adds an image attachment from data.

methods.name: removeAttachment
methods.description: Removes an attachment by its ID.
